entities.name: Myczil Savod Zunich
entities.description: Quarter-human, quarter-Silhana, half-Devkarin son of Fonn Zunich and Jarad vod Savo; later huntmaster of the Devkarin.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Golgari guildmaster and Myc's father, who becomes a kind of lich.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: Rakdos blood witch who tried to use Myc's blood to control Rakdos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos, mind-bound to Myc by the ritual.

entities.name: Devkarin
entities.description: Elves of whom Myc is huntmaster.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Tricked Myc and Cevraya, then offered protection.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Helped Vraska trick Myc and Cevraya.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: Golgari matka falsely blamed for the spider attack.

events.summary: Rakdos cultists capture Myc and Izolda attempts the domination ritual; Jarad's arrow spills the blood mixture over Rakdos and Myc, binding their minds.
Myc and Rakdos go on a rampage in Ravnica.
events.quote: Myc and Rakdos then went on a rampage in the city of Ravnica.

events.summary: Jarad's sacrifice to Izolda breaks the bond, and Fonn rescues Myc; Jarad becomes a kind of lich and Myc chooses the Golgari.
events.quote: Myc decided to stay with his father and follow the ways of Golgari.

events.summary: Myc becomes huntmaster of the Devkarin.
events.quote: Myc became the huntmaster of the Devkarin

events.summary: Vraska and Dovin trick Myc and Cevraya into blaming Izoni, and both accept Vraska's protection.
events.quote: Both Myczil and Cevraya consequently accepted the protection of Vraska.
